points.description: States the exact ZOH discretisation formulae before substituting: F = e^(AT) and G = (integral from 0 to T of e^(Aτ) dτ) B (or equivalent A^-1 (F - I) B for invertible A). Both F and G formulae needed. Forward Euler (F = 1+AT, G = TB) or Tustin formulae do not earn this mark as 'exact' formulae.

levels.says: Only one of the two formulae (F or G) correctly stated, or a correct, clearly labelled Euler/Tustin discretisation stated instead of the exact one.

points.description: Correct F = e^(-0.2) ≈ 0.8187 (evaluated numerically, accept 0.819). Unevaluated e^-0.2 earns half. Euler value 0.8 earns nothing.

levels.says: Correct exponent e^(-0.2) given but not evaluated numerically.

points.description: Correct G = (1 - e^(-0.2))/2 ≈ 0.0906 (accept 0.09063 or 0.0906). Unevaluated expression, G = 0.1 (Euler), or sign-inverted -0.0906 earns nothing.

rubric.notes: Full marks: both exact formulae stated, F ≈ 0.8187 and G ≈ 0.0906. Missing G gives 2 (formulae + F). Euler or Tustin (F=0.8, G=0.1) gets at most 1 mark; a sign-inverted G (-0.0906) gets 2; correct method with F and G unevaluated gets at most 1.5 (formula mark plus half the F mark), capped at 1 if it amounts to Euler.
